The '''E-11 blaster pistol''' was a type of weapon used in the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zeerid Korr]] sometimes wore an E-11 [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] in a single-sling [[Holster/Legends|holster]] under his jacket, and carried the blaster in place of a pair of [[GH-44 blaster]]s.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The E-11 [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which was published in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
